# Milestone 4d, the library: movies looked up, refreshed, added, edited,
# moved and deleted, and the settings written. A recording of its own, so
# that the long list next door did not have to be recorded again; same
# format, and signalr.json holds what the hub sent after each step.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-library/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-library make golden-radarr
#
# The original reaches api.radarr.video, the Servarr services and TMDB's
# images through scripts/mock-servarr.py, which becomes its HTTP proxy
# here: certificate validation off for the mock's self-signed tunnels, the
# fixture's dead *.invalid providers bypassed so that they fail as before.
# The fixture's own AllowedHosts '*' is refused by the validation of the
# same PUT first. RECORD_METADATA=1 lets the mock fetch an answer that
# tests/fixtures/metadata does not have yet.
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-allowedhosts-star PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy-star.json
config-host-put-proxy PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy.json
sleep 8
config-host-after-proxy GET /api/v3/config/host
health-after-proxy GET /api/v3/health

# Lookups. A term whose movie is in the library (The Holdovers, without a
# file), ids of a movie with a file (Air), of one the library does not
# have (Dune, part of a collection), of one the lists exclude (Titane);
# ids nobody has; a link; a release name, whose title and year are what
# is searched for; no term at all, which the original answers 503.
movie-lookup-library GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=the%20holdovers
movie-lookup-library-file GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=tmdb:964980
movie-lookup-tmdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=tmdb:438631
movie-lookup-tmdbid GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=TmdbId:%20438631
movie-lookup-imdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=imdb:tt1160419
movie-lookup-excluded GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=tmdb:630240
movie-lookup-tmdb-missing GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=tmdb:999999999
movie-lookup-tmdb-not-a-number GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=tmdb:dune
movie-lookup-imdb-missing GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=imdb:tt9999999999
movie-lookup-url-tmdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=https://www.themoviedb.org/movie/438631-dune
movie-lookup-url-imdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1160419/
movie-lookup-release-name GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=Titane.2021.1080p.BluRay.x264-GRP
movie-lookup-empty GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=
movie-lookup-no-term GET /api/v3/movie/lookup
movie-lookup-route-tmdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/tmdb?tmdbId=438631
movie-lookup-route-tmdb-missing GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/tmdb?tmdbId=999999999
movie-lookup-route-imdb GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/imdb?imdbId=tt1160419
movie-lookup-route-imdb-missing GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/imdb?imdbId=tt9999999999

# A manual refresh of one movie: its metadata, alternative titles,
# translations and credits from the metadata server, its covers, a rescan.
command-refresh-movie POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-refresh-movie.json
sleep 20
command-refresh-movie-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-refresh-movie}
movie-116-after-refresh GET /api/v3/movie/116
credit-116-after-refresh GET /api/v3/credit?movieId=116
alttitle-116-after-refresh GET /api/v3/alttitle?movieId=116

# Three more: one with a file (Air), one still in cinemas (The Odyssey),
# and one the metadata server answers 404 for (The Great Beyond, by a
# hand-made fixture): it is marked as deleted and the health says so.
command-refresh-movies POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-refresh-movies.json
sleep 25
command-refresh-movies-get GET /api/v3/command/{id:command-refresh-movies}
movie-5-after-refresh GET /api/v3/movie/5
movie-125-after-refresh GET /api/v3/movie/125
movie-186-after-refresh GET /api/v3/movie/186
health-after-refresh GET /api/v3/health

# Adding a movie. What the validation refuses first, one rule at a time:
# neither a path nor a root folder, a root folder that is none, a path
# that is relative, that is a root folder, that another movie has, a
# profile that does not exist, none at all, no TMDB id, a movie the
# library has, one TMDB does not.
movie-add-no-path POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-no-path.json
movie-add-missing-root POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-missing-root.json
movie-add-relative-path POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-relative-path.json
movie-add-root-as-path POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-root-as-path.json
movie-add-taken-path POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-taken-path.json
movie-add-missing-profile POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-missing-profile.json
movie-add-no-profile POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-no-profile.json
movie-add-no-tmdb POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-no-tmdb.json
movie-add-existing POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-existing.json
movie-add-unknown POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-unknown.json

# Dune, as the Add New page sends it: the lookup's answer with a root
# folder, a profile, a tag and the options. Its collection is in the
# library already (Dune: Part Three is). The movie is refreshed and
# scanned; nothing is searched for.
movie-add POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add.json
sleep 20
movie-added GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}
movie-added-by-tmdb GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=438631
movie-added-credits GET /api/v3/credit?movieId={id:movie-add}
command-after-add GET /api/v3/command

# Blade Runner 2049, monitored with its collection and searched for. The
# library does not have the collection: it comes with the movie, is
# refreshed (its other movie becomes known) and ends up monitored.
movie-lookup-route-tmdb-collection GET /api/v3/movie/lookup/tmdb?tmdbId=335984
movie-add-collection POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-collection.json
sleep 30
movie-added-collection GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-collection}
collection-after-add GET /api/v3/collection
command-after-add-collection GET /api/v3/command

# The collection brought its other movie, Blade Runner, into the library
# by being monitored: adding it by hand now is refused.
movie-add-by-collection POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-by-collection.json
movie-brought-by-collection GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=78

# A movie added under a path of its own, unmonitored, with no more than
# its TMDB id and a title (Whiplash).
movie-add-path POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path.json
sleep 20
movie-added-path GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-path}
health-after-add GET /api/v3/health

# Editing a movie. What the validation refuses: a profile that does not
# exist, a path that is a root folder, that is empty, that another movie
# has; a movie that does not exist. Then Dune as the edit form sends it
# back, unmonitored, with another profile, availability and tags.
movie-put-missing-profile PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add} bodies/movie-put-missing-profile.json
movie-put-root-as-path PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add} bodies/movie-put-root-as-path.json
movie-put-empty-path PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add} bodies/movie-put-empty-path.json
movie-put-taken-path PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add} bodies/movie-put-taken-path.json
movie-put-missing PUT /api/v3/movie/999999 bodies/movie-put-missing.json
movie-put PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add} bodies/movie-put.json
movie-after-put GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}

# Its folder moved with it: a file is put in the folder and found by a
# rescan, then the path is changed with moveFiles. The folder and its
# file follow; the file's row keeps its relative path.
mock - POST /mock/fs/write?path=/movies/Dune%20(2021)%20{tmdb-438631}/Dune.2021.1080p.BluRay.x264-GRP.mkv&clip=episode-1080
command-rescan-added POST /api/v3/command bodies/command-rescan-added.json
sleep 12
movie-after-rescan GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}
movie-put-move PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}?moveFiles=true bodies/movie-put-move.json
sleep 10
command-after-move GET /api/v3/command
movie-after-move GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}
filesystem-after-move GET /api/v3/filesystem?path=/movies/Dune%20Moved/&includeFiles=true
filesystem-movies-after-move GET /api/v3/filesystem?path=/movies/

# A path changed without moveFiles: the row alone.
movie-put-path PUT /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-path} bodies/movie-put-path.json

# The editor of the movie index, on two movies: fields, tags added,
# replaced and removed; a root folder that is none, a profile that is
# none; then a root folder with moveFiles, which gives each movie the
# folder the naming would and moves the one that has a folder on disk;
# and a root folder without moveFiles, which keeps the folder's name.
movie-editor PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor.json
movie-editor-replace-tags PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-replace-tags.json
movie-editor-remove-tags PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-remove-tags.json
movie-editor-missing-root PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-missing-root.json
movie-editor-missing-profile PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-missing-profile.json
movie-editor-move PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-move.json
sleep 10
command-after-editor-move GET /api/v3/command
movie-after-editor-move GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}
movie-path-after-editor-move GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-path}
filesystem-movies-after-editor-move GET /api/v3/filesystem?path=/movies/
movie-editor-root PUT /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-root.json

# Deleting. Dune with its files and an exclusion: the folder goes, the
# lists will not bring it back. A movie that does not exist. Blade Runner
# 2049 with nothing else, then Blade Runner through the editor: the
# collection the two of them brought has no movie left and goes too.
movie-delete DELETE /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}?deleteFiles=true&addImportExclusion=true
sleep 8
movie-deleted GET /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add}
moviefile-after-delete GET /api/v3/moviefile?movieId={id:movie-add}
history-after-delete GET /api/v3/history/movie?movieId={id:movie-add}
exclusions-after-delete GET /api/v3/exclusions
filesystem-movies-after-delete GET /api/v3/filesystem?path=/movies/
movie-delete-missing DELETE /api/v3/movie/999999
movie-delete-plain DELETE /api/v3/movie/{id:movie-add-collection}
movie-editor-delete DELETE /api/v3/movie/editor bodies/movie-editor-delete.json
sleep 8
collection-after-delete GET /api/v3/collection
movie-list-after-delete GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=78
health-after-delete GET /api/v3/health

# Library Import: several movies added together under folders that are

movie-imported-second GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=49047

exclusion-bulk-create POST /api/v3/exclusions/bulk bodies/exclusion-bulk-create.json
exclusion-paged GET /api/v3/exclusions/paged?page=1&pageSize=5&sortKey=tmdbId&sortDirection=descending
exclusion-delete DELETE /api/v3/exclusions/{id:exclusion-create}
exclusion-delete-missing DELETE /api/v3/exclusions/9999
exclusion-bulk-delete DELETE /api/v3/exclusions/bulk bodies/exclusion-bulk-delete.json
exclusion-after GET /api/v3/exclusions

# Collections: one changed, which monitors it and so brings the movie
# of its that is out and that neither the library nor the exclusions
# have (Dune: Part Two; Dune itself was deleted with an exclusion);
# then several at once.
collection-41 GET /api/v3/collection/41
collection-put PUT /api/v3/collection/41 bodies/collection-put.json
sleep 25
collection-after-put GET /api/v3/collection/41
movie-brought-by-collection-put GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=693134
command-after-collection-put GET /api/v3/command
collection-put-missing PUT /api/v3/collection/9999 bodies/collection-put-missing.json
collections-put PUT /api/v3/collection bodies/collections-put.json
sleep 8
collection-after-bulk GET /api/v3/collection/41
health-after-settings GET /api/v3/health
